title: 第2260章 分赃第2259章 干不干
content_zh:
“小丫头，你确实有几分本事。”他擦去嘴角的血迹，声音沙哑，“但也仅此而已。”
“接下来这一招，我看你还怎么挡！”
他深吸一口气，双手再次结印，周身的黑色光芒再次暴涨，那尊黑色虚影重新凝聚，比之前更加庞大，更加凝实，散发出的威压也更加恐怖。
洛云汐的脸色有些难看，这中年男子的实力似乎在仙尊巅峰这一层次也算是顶尖的存在。
“叶无尘，你再不出手，姑奶奶就要交代在这里了！”她转头朝叶无尘的方向喊道。
话音刚落，一道幽紫色的星光从远处破空而来，速度快到了极致，如同一道流星划破夜空。
中年男子的瞳孔猛然收缩，他猛地转头，只见一道白衣身影不知何时已经出现在了他身侧三丈处。
“你……”
中年男子的话还没说完，叶无尘的指尖已经轻轻点出。
那道幽紫色的星辰剑气破空而出，速度快到了极致，在虚空中留下一道淡淡的紫痕。
中年男子想要闪避，但那道剑气的速度实在太快了，他的身形刚刚移动，剑气便已经洞穿了他的右肩。
“啊！”
中年男子发出一声惨叫，右肩处鲜血飞溅，整条右臂无力地垂落下来。
他的身形踉跄后退，那双眸子中满是惊骇。
他万万没想到，这个一直站在一旁、只有仙境巅峰修为的白衣青年，出手竟然如此狠辣，如此精准。
一剑，便废了他一条手臂。
“你……你是谁？”中年男子的声音中带着几分颤抖，他能感觉到，那道剑气中蕴含的力量极为恐怖，绝非普通仙境修士能够拥有的力量。
叶无尘没有回答，只是静静地站在那里，指尖处再次凝聚出一道星辰剑气。
“叶无尘，别跟他废话，直接杀了他！”洛云汐从地上爬起来，提着巨锤跑了过来，那张精致的小脸上满是怒意，“敢让姑奶奶陪你喝酒，姑奶奶今天非把他砸成肉饼不可！”
中年男子的脸色彻底变了。

一个力量恐怖的仙尊中阶小丫头已经够他喝一壶的了，现在又多了一个实力深不可测的白衣青年，而且这白衣青年的剑气威力极强，连他都挡不住。
“两位，有话好说！”他的声音中带着几分慌乱，“方才是在下有眼不识泰山，冒犯了两位，还望两位见谅！”
“见谅？”洛云汐冷笑一声，“你刚才不是说要让姑奶奶陪你喝酒吗？还想要我们的储物戒？现在知道求饶了？”
“是在下的错，是在下的错！”中年男子连连拱手，额头上渗出了细密的汗珠，“在下愿意赔偿两位的损失，只求两位饶在下一命！”
“饶你蛋蛋！”洛云汐低喝一声，手中巨锤猛地砸落。
嗡！
巨锤在砸下时瞬间变大数倍，将大半个虚空都遮蔽。
“不！不！”眼看着那巨锤将要砸下，那中年男惊恐地嘶吼着。
他万万没想到，自己身为仙尊巅峰的人物，竟会栽在一个小丫头跟一个青年手中。
然而，任凭他如何嘶吼，洛云汐自然是不会放过他的。
今日若非叶无尘与洛云汐实力强大，那中年男子将他们击败之后，也必定会将他们诛杀。
content_en:
"Little girl, you do have some abilities." He wiped the blood from the corner of his mouth, his voice hoarse, "But that's all."
"Let me see how you can block this next move!"
He took a deep breath, formed seals with his hands again, and the black light around him surged again. The black shadow regrouped, becoming larger and more solid than before, and the pressure it exuded was even more terrifying.
Luo Yunxi's face looked a little ugly. The strength of this middle-aged man seemed to be at the top of the level of the Immortal Master.
"Ye Wuchen, if you don't take action, my aunt will be punished here!" She turned her head and shouted in the direction of Ye Wuchen.
As soon as he finished speaking, a faint purple starlight broke through the sky from a distance, and the speed reached the extreme, like a meteor piercing the night sky.
The middle-aged man's pupils shrank suddenly, and he turned his head suddenly, only to see a figure in white appearing three feet away from him at some point.
"You..."
Before the middle-aged man could finish speaking, Ye Wuchen's fingertips had already tapped out.
The purple star sword energy shot out of the sky at an extremely fast speed, leaving a faint purple mark in the void.
The middle-aged man wanted to dodge, but the speed of the sword energy was too fast. As soon as he moved, the sword energy penetrated his right shoulder.
"Ah!"
The middle-aged man let out a scream, blood splattered on his right shoulder, and his entire right arm hung down weakly.
His figure staggered back, his eyes full of horror.
He never expected that this young man in white who had been standing aside and had only the peak level of cultivation in the fairyland would be so cruel and precise.
With one strike of the sword, one of his arms was crippled.
"You...who are you?" The middle-aged man's voice was trembling. He could feel that the power contained in the sword energy was extremely terrifying, and it was definitely not a power that ordinary fairyland monks could possess.
Ye Wuchen didn't answer, just stood there quietly, a star sword energy condensed at his fingertips again.
"Ye Wuchen, don't talk nonsense to him, just kill him!" Luo Yunxi got up from the ground and ran over with a giant hammer, her delicate little face full of anger, "If you dare to let my aunt drink with you, my aunt will smash him into a meat pie today!"
The middle-aged man's expression completely changed.
A middle-level Immortal Lord girl with terrifying power is enough for him to drink a pot of. Now there is a young man in white with unfathomable strength. Moreover, the sword energy of this young man in white is so powerful that even he can't stop it.
"You two, you have something to say!" There was a hint of panic in his voice, "I just didn't know the truth, and I offended you two. I hope you can forgive me!"
"Excuse me?" Luo Yunxi sneered, "Didn't you just say that you wanted my aunt to accompany you to drink? You still want our storage ring? Now you know how to beg for mercy?"
"It's my fault, it's my fault!" The middle-aged man held up his hands repeatedly, beads of sweat oozing out from his forehead, "I am willing to compensate you two for your losses. I only ask that you spare your life!"
"Spare your balls!" Luo Yunxi shouted and slammed down the giant hammer in his hand.
Buzz!
The giant hammer instantly grew several times in size when it hit it, covering most of the void.
"No! No!" Seeing that the giant hammer was about to hit, the middle-aged man roared in horror.
He never expected that as a person at the pinnacle of immortality, he would fall into the hands of a little girl and a young man.
However, no matter how much he roared, Luo Yunxi would not let him go.
If Ye Wuchen and Luo Yunxi were not powerful today, the middle-aged man would definitely kill them after defeating them.
